Symptom: Curved pattern in residuals vs. fitted or key feature
Likely fixes: Add spline/polynomial terms; introduce interactions; try GAMs; switch to trees/boosting; kernel methods
Quick checks: Residuals vs. fitted/feature plots; partial residual plots

Symptom: Funnel shape: variance grows/shrinks with level
Likely fixes: Transform target (log, Box–Cox, Yeo–Johnson); Weighted/Generalized Least Squares; model variance; use quantile regression
Add lags & seasonal terms; ARIMA errors; state-space/GLS; time-aware CV; scheduled retraining

Likely cause: Missing features, distributional shift, or bias
Likely fixes: Group intercepts/random effects; interactions; reweight/stratify; per-group calibration; collect missing features
Quick checks: Residual means by subgroup with CIs; permutation tests

Symptom: Few very large residuals/high leverage points
Likely fixes: Robust loss (Huber/Tukey); winsorize/clip with care; investigate data quality; train an anomaly detector
Use t-distributed errors; quantile regression; switch to appropriate GLM family
Poisson/NegBin for counts; Gamma/Lognormal for positives; Beta for rates; zero-inflated models
Add spatial features (lat/long splines, geohash, distances); spatial random effects; Gaussian processes; cluster-robust SEs
Quick checks: Moran’s I; residuals vs. location maps

Symptom: Classification: predicted probabilities off observed rates
Likely fixes: Temperature scaling; isotonic/Platt; per-group calibration; conformal prediction for coverage

Symptom: Binned residuals change with a feature
Likely fixes: Add interaction/monotonic constraints; transform feature; use GAM/monotonic GBM

Symptom: Errors spike at extremes of target/feature
Likely fixes: Collect edge-case data; piecewise/segmented models; monotonic constraints; conservative intervals
Quick checks: Residuals vs. target/feature quantiles; leverage in extremes

Symptom: Train residuals tiny, validation/test residuals large
Likely fixes: Stronger regularization; simpler model; proper CV; remove leakage features; early stopping
Quick checks: Compare train vs. val residuals; time-series CV if temporal

Likely fixes: Monitor residuals; drift detection; recalibrate; reweight (covariate shift); retrain
Quick checks: PSI/KS/Wasserstein on features/residuals; rolling residual mean

Likely fixes: Add relevant covariates; apply fairness constraints (equalized odds, DP); reweighing/post-processing; audit intersections
Quick checks: Residuals by protected groups; fairness metrics per group

Symptom: Pattern only in a local range of a feature
Likely fixes: Local models (kNN/GBDT); piecewise/segmented regression; feature binning

Symptom: Prediction variance too low vs. empirical spread
Likely fixes: Ensembles/bootstraps; Bayesian models; heteroskedastic variance modeling; conformal intervals
Quick checks: Coverage/PIT tests; backtest interval hit rates

Symptom: Classifier outputs clustered near 0.5 despite separability
Likely cause: Underfit or insufficient features/regularization too high
